headline: Without direction, interest fades.
headlineAccent: With the right page, it moves forward.
subtitle: Your offer deserves a page designed to present, persuade and convert.
messages: Having something good to offer is only the beginning.
Without structure, interest has nowhere to go.
Every detail begins to serve a purpose.
Now, interest knows where to go.
closing: Now see how this can work for you.
price: R$ 800 development + R$ 200/month for 6 months, including hosting, support and maintenance. Domain billed separately.
sceneAlt: One ORBIT package moves through two environments. The same scattered presentation is reorganized: the headline, benefits and call to action gain hierarchy, while the product stays the same.
demoDescription: A kit to organize your ideas and make room for what matters.
handoff: A page starts with your goal.
handoffDescription: From first impressions to the next action, every choice can work for your offer. Let's talk about what you want to achieve.
staticNote: The product stays the same. Hierarchy, benefits and a clear next step make the offer easier to understand.
